latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of ucts-office-hours.

- Run a structured product strategy session using 6 focused questions.
- Push for specific, real-world examples and challenge vague statements.
- Guide the user to define pain points, key personas, workarounds, ideal experiences, minimum testable solution, and a single metric.
- After questioning, reframe the problem, suggest 3 implementation approaches (with effort estimates), and recommend a path.
- Designed to work directly in OpenClaw—no Claude Code session required.
